# moodle-cli 0.7.0-alpha.2

This prerelease makes the managed Cloudflare MCP deployment usable from a clean account and keeps the complete 0.7.0 alpha feature set available for validation.

## 0.7.0 alpha feature set

- Download one authenticated Moodle resource with `moodle download` or `moodle dl`, including atomic writes, overwrite protection, and structured receipts.
- Deploy and manage a private Cloudflare Worker MCP server with `moodle mcp deploy`, `status`, `login`, `connect`, and `remove`.
- Keep Moodle sessions encrypted in a Durable Object, renew them locally, and expose read-only Moodle tools over MCP `2026-07-28` with `2025-11-25` compatibility.

## Fixed in alpha.2

- Apply the first Durable Object migration with a standard deploy before creating versioned releases.
- Support Durable Object Workers that do not receive preview URLs, then promote, validate, and restore releases transactionally.
- Use Wrangler's real account-subdomain endpoint instead of constructing an invalid workers.dev URL.
- Retry bounded Cloudflare route, secret, and Durable Object propagation across session, health, readiness, and MCP smoke requests.
- Call runtime-global `fetch` without an invalid receiver inside Cloudflare Workers.
- Remove partially created Workers and restore the previous release and credentials when deployment fails.
- Invalidate stale local receipts when their remote Worker no longer exists.
- Include sanitized service diagnostics when `moodle mcp status --verbose` is requested.

## Validation

- Complete Node and Bun suites: 263 passed, with the Windows-only protected-store integration test assigned to Windows CI.
- Typechecking, CLI and Worker builds, npm package checks, installed-tarball smoke tests, generated-skill drift checks, and the compiled standalone smoke test passed.
- A clean disposable Cloudflare deployment completed all eight onboarding stages against a live Moodle session.
- Live checks passed for liveness, authenticated readiness, MCP initialization, `tools/list`, and verbose CLI status.
- The disposable Worker was removed and existing Codex, Claude, VS Code, and Cursor configuration files were unchanged.

The `alpha` npm dist-tag moves to this release. The stable `latest` dist-tag remains on `0.6.0`.
